bible_verses.telugu: ఆ పెద్దలలో ఒకడుఏడువకుము; ఇదిగో దావీదుకు చిగురైన యూదా గోత్రపు సింహము ఏడు ముద్రలను తీసి ఆ గ్రంథమును విప్పుటకై జయముపొందెనని నాతో చెప్పెను.
bible_verses.english: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals.”

bible_verses.telugu: భూమి క్రింద ఉన్నవారిలో గాని, ప్రతివాని మోకాలును యేసునామమున వంగునట్లును, ప్రతివాని నాలుకయు తండ్రియైన దేవుని మహిమార్థమై యేసుక్రీస్తు ప్రభువని ఒప్పుకొనునట్లును, దేవుడు ఆయనను అధికముగా హెచ్చించి, ప్రతి నామ మునకు పైనామమును ఆయనకు అనుగ్రహించెను.
bible_verses.english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth, and every tongue acknowledge that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

bible_verses.telugu: ఇదిగో ఆయన మేఘా రూఢుడై వచ్చుచున్నాడు; ప్రతి నేత్రము ఆయనను చూచును, ఆయనను పొడిచినవారును చూచెదరు; భూజనులందరు ఆయనను చూచి రొమ్ము కొట్టుకొందురు; అవును ఆమేన్‌.
bible_verses.english: “Look, he is coming with the clouds,” and “every eye will see him, even those who pierced him”; and all peoples on earth “will mourn because of him.” So shall it be! Amen.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my fierce Protector and my humble Savior. You fought the ultimate battle on the cross to break every chain in my life, and You reign victorious today. When I face worries or battles I cannot fight on my own, remind me that You are roaring on my behalf. I yield my heart to You, bowing before You as my Lord, my Lion, and my Lamb. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my fierce Protector and my humble Savior. You fought the ultimate battle on the cross to break every chain in my life, and You reign victorious today. When I face worries or battles I cannot fight on my own, remind me that You are roaring on my behalf. I yield my heart to You, bowing before You as my Lord, my Lion, and my Lamb. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: In Jesus, we see a beautiful paradox: He is both the roaring Lion who fights our battles and the gentle Lamb who bore our sins. When life feels overwhelming, this song reminds us that no power can stand against the Lord Almighty. His sacrificial love breaks every chain of fear and shame, inviting us to surrender our heavy burdens to Him. Today, let your heart rest in His fierce protection and bow in joyful worship before the One who reigns supreme.
